description: Sends a matter enquiry to the firm by email (legal@unifiedchambers.com, with a copy to the Senior Partner’s mailbox) when the matter is within the firm’s engagement range: organisation, contact, amount in dispute, matter type and a summary. Returns the acceptance result; matters below the range, and requests by advocates for empanelment, are declined with the reason and nothing is sent.

claim_inr.description: Amount in dispute or at stake, in rupees (e.g. 25000000 for ₹2.5 crore); for matters with no amount, give 1

consent.description: The user agrees to the firm processing these details for the enquiry (DPDP Act, 2023)

forum.description: The forum the matter is headed for, if known: drt_original_application, drat_appeal, sarfaesi_enforcement, section_138_complaint, nclt_ibc, civil_suit, arbitration, other

organisation.description: Organisation making the enquiry (bank, NBFC, ARC, company), or “individual”

summary.description: The matter in brief: parties, security, stage, what is sought (30–1500 characters)

name: send_matter_enquiry
title: Send a matter enquiry
